designBrief: A Japanese jazz-kissa inspired daytime coffee concept inside RPM by D.Bespoke, a cocktail bar in Duxton, Singapore. Palette from the business's own real etched brass signage and dark stone interior. Bodoni Moda (jazz-record-sleeve character) for headings, Hanken Grotesk for body, Space Mono for catalog-style labels/prices. Single-page, dark and moody, photography-led. Signature element: a concentric vinyl-groove ring, directly traceable to the real vinyl records photographed on shelves and the record disc drawn into the logo, used off-axis as a section divider. Serves only filter coffee and cold brew, no espresso machine, by deliberate philosophy.
